scope: Actual current DesktopBuddy HTML/CSS, 320CSSpx local API fixtures, actual same-component local preview at392px and320CSSpx on controlled light/dark/busy backgrounds. No native/provider/microphone session.
method: W3C sRGB luminance from computed foreground (including inherited opacity) against the rendered PNG background under actual glyph paint. Paired original/glyph-hidden PNGs supply a difference mask within direct-text Range line boxes; the mask only locates painted text, never supplies its foreground colour. Native textarea content boxes use the same mask. Every masked background pixel is checked; unused font bearings and rounded-rim corners outside text are excluded. Glyph paint temporarily removed while preserving layout, borders, surfaces and decorative sibling/pseudo layers; exact inline styles restored. Minimum ratio per text element. Main reading target7:1; labels4.5:1 separately. This is not a physical-display or antialiased-glyph measurement.
